honest_conclusion: Authoritative book (0.85 R05 + 0.15 residual-mom EW, overlay OFF, n=268): net Sharpe (official arithmetic) 1.5599 (CAGR/vol 1.6831), CAGR 35.4%, MDD 35.1%, Calmar 1.01, PORT_t 4.90. The CAGR/vol SR CONFIRMS the optimizer design (1.701) within rounding. HOWEVER, after the Codex-driven revision, the diversifier case is materially WEAKER than the draft implied: (1) the book-marginal ΔIR is NOT robustly positive — it is +0.059 under PIT-correct realized-month BM but -0.006 under the optimizer's BM, and the alignment-independent incremental book-vs-R05 return is NEGATIVE in-sample (-1.85%/yr, t -2.17) and FLAT out-of-sample (+0.29%/yr, t 0.09); (2) standalone alpha FAILED (t 1.46); (3) active-vs-BM oos_retention HARD-fails (0.171 / -0.149 at the 2024-01 lockbox). The residual-mom sleeve is at best a weak vol/beta shaper, NOT a return-additive diversifier. SR-2.5 is NOT reached (1.56 authoritative). Overlay ON gives MDD control (35%->22%) but no SR lift and hurts active IR. RECOMMENDATION (aligns with + strengthens optimizer): this is a LOW/NO-conviction marginal diversifier; the real lever is DPL (measurement-graduation §5), not more sleeve/overlay stacking. Governor admit NOT recommended.
